worked_solution:
Since the graph of $f(x)$ passes through $(-2,5)$, we have that $f(-2)=5.$ Therefore, the tangent line approximation of $f(x)$ at $a=-2$ is 

$$
\begin{aligned}L(x) & =f(a)+{f}^{′}(a)(x-a) \\  & =f(-2)+{f}^{′}(-2)(x-(-2)) \\  & =5+(-3)(x+2) \\  & =5-3x-6 \\  & =-3x-1.\end{aligned}
$$
